G4672.def:
**Σολομών**, -ῶνος (so prop., but Rec. has frequently -ῶν, -ῶντος, as also WH in [[Act.3.11; 5.12|Act.3:11 5:12]]; in [[Act.7.47|Act.7:47]] T has Σαλωμών, as LXX freq., indecl.; see B1., § 10, 1; Tdf., Prol., 104, 119; WH, _App._, 158), ὁ (Heb. שְׁלֹמֹה),
**Solomon**: [[Mat.1.6-7; 6.29; 12.42|Mat.1:6-7 6:29 12:42]], [[Luk.11.31; 12.27|Luk.11:31 12:27]], [[Jhn.10.23|Jhn.10:23]], [[Act.3.11; 5.12; 7.47|Act.3:11 5:12 7:47]].†
(AS)

G4666.def:
**σμύρνα**
(in some MSS, ζμ-; see Bl., § 3, 9), -ης, ἡ, [in LXX for מֹר ;]
**myrrh, a resinous gum used as an unguent and for em­balming**: [[Mat.2.11|Mat.2:11]], [[Jhn.19.39|Jhn.19:39]].†
(AS)

G4655.def:
**σκότος**, -ου, ὁ the more usual cl. form (cf.σ., τό),
**darkness**: [[Heb.12.18|Heb.12:18]], Rec.†
(AS)

G4639.def:
**σκιά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for צֵל, [[4Ki.20.9|4Ki.20:9]] ff., [[Psa.57.1|Psa.57:1]], al.; but σ. and σ. θανάτου are also used for צַלְמָוֶת, [[Job.3.5|Job.3:5]], [[Psa.3.4|Psa.3:4]], [[Isa.9.2|Isa.9:2]] (1) (see _ICC_, in l), al. ;]
1. **shadow, shade, caused by interception of light**: [[Mrk.4.32|Mrk.4:32]], [[Act.5.15|Act.5:15]]; metaphorically, σ. θανάτου, of ignorance and error, [[Mat.4.16|Mat.4:16]], [[Luk.1.79|Luk.1:79]]" (LXX) .
2. **a shadow, the image or outline cast by an object**: figuratively, ὑπόδειγμα καὶ σ., [[Heb.8.5|Heb.8:5]] opposite to σῶμα, [[Col.2.17|Col.2:17]] opposite to εἰκών, [[Heb.10.1|Heb.10:1]]†
(AS)

G4613.def:
**Σίμων**, -ωνος, ὁ
a Greek name (transliterated סִימוֺן in _Heb._) used as a substitute for Συμεών (which see), Simon
1. **Simon Peter**: [[Mat.17.25|Mat.17:25]], [[Mrk.1.29|Mrk.1:29]], al.
2. **Simon the Zealot **(see: ζηλωτής, Καναναῖος): [[Mat.10.4|Mat.10:4]], [[Mrk.3.18|Mrk.3:18]], [[Luk.6.15|Luk.6:15]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]].
3. **One of the Brethren of our Lord **(see: ἀδελψός): [[Mat.13.55|Mat.13:55]], [[Mrk.6.3|Mrk.6:3]].
4. **The father of Judas Iscariot, himself surnamed Ἰσκαριώτης **(which see): [[Jhn.6.71; 12.4|Jhn.6:71 12:4]] (Rec.) 13:2,26
5. **Simon the Cyrenian**: [[Mat.27.32|Mat.27:32]], [[Mrk.15.21|Mrk.15:21]], [[Luk.23.26|Luk.23:26]].
6. **Simon the Pharisee**: [[Luk.7.40, 43-44|Luk.7:40, 43-44]].
7. **Simon of Bethany, surnamed ὁ λεπρός**: [[Mat.26.6|Mat.26:6]], [[Mrk.14.3|Mrk.14:3]].
8. **Simon Magus, a Samaritan sorcerer**: [[Act.8.9, 13; 8.18, 24|Act.8:9, 13 8:18, 24]].
9. **Simon the tanner, of Joppa**: [[Act.9.43; 10.6, 17; 10.32|Act.9:43 10:6, 17 10:32]]
(AS)

G4624.def:
**σκανδαλίζω**
(σκάνδαλον), [in LXX: Dan LXX 11:41 (כָּשַׁל ni.), [[Sir.9.5|Sir.9:5]] ([[Sir.35.15; 32.15|Sir.35:15 32:15]]) (יָקֹשׁ ho.) [[Sir.23.8|Sir.23:8]] (also in Aq., Sm., _Th._, and in Psa Sol [[Psa.16.7|Psa.16:7]] not elsewhere, except NT and eccl.)* ;]
prop., to put a snare or stumbling-block in the way; in NT always metaphorically of that which hinders right conduct or thought, **to cause to stumble**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.5.29-30; 17.27; 18.6, 8-9|Mat.5:29-30 17:27 18:6, 8-9]] [[Mrk.9.42-43, 45; 9.47|Mrk.9:42-43, 45 9:47]] [[Luk.17.2|Luk.17:2]], [[Jhn.6.61|Jhn.6:61]], [[1Co.8.13|1Co.8:13]]. Pass., **to be made to stumble, to stumble**: [[Mat.11.6; 13.21, 57; 15.12; 24.10; 26.31, 33|Mat.11:6 13:21, 57 15:12 24:10 26:31, 33]], [[Mrk.4.17; 6.3; 14.27, 29|Mrk.4:17 6:3 14:27, 29]], [[Luk.7.23|Luk.7:23]], [[Jhn.16.1|Jhn.16:1]], [[Rom.14.21|Rom.14:21]] (WH, R, txt., om.), [[2Co.11.29|2Co.11:29]],†
(AS)

G4600.def:
**σιαγών**, -όνος, ἡ
[in LXX for לְחִי ;]
**the jawbone, jaw, cheek**: [[Mat.5.39|Mat.5:39]], [[Luk.6.29|Luk.6:29]] (cf. MM, xxii).†
(AS)

G4659.def:
**σκυθρωπός**, -όν (also -ή, -όν)
(σκυθρός, sullen, + ὤψ), [in LXX: [[Gen.40.7|Gen.40:7]] (רַע), etc. ;]
**of a gloomy countenance**: [[Mat.6.16|Mat.6:16]], [[Luk.24.17|Luk.24:17]].†
(AS)

G4652.def:
**σκοτεινός (WH. -τινός)**, -ή, -όν
(σκότος), [in LXX chiefly for חֹשֶׁךְ and cogn. forms ;]
**dark**: opposite to φωτεινός, [[Mat.6.23|Mat.6:23]], [[Luk.11.34, 36|Luk.11:34, 36]].†
(AS)

G4697.def:
**σπλαγχνίζομαι**
(σπλάγχνον), [in LXX (act., -ίζω): [[Pro.17.5|Pro.17:5]] A, [[2Ma.6.8|2Ma.6:8]] (= -εύω) * ;]
to be moved as to the σπλάγχνα (which see), **hence, to feel pity or compassion**: absol., [[Luk.10.33; 15.20|Luk.10:33 15:20]]; ptcp., σπλαγχνισθείς, with indic., [[Mat.18.27; 20.34|Mat.18:27 20:34]], [[Mrk.1.41|Mrk.1:41]]; before ἐπί, with dative of person(s), [[Mat.14.14|Mat.14:14]], [[Luk.7.13|Luk.7:13]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[Mat.15.32|Mat.15:32]], [[Mrk.6.34; 8.2; 9.22|Mrk.6:34 8:2 9:22]]; ωερί, [[Mat.9.36|Mat.9:36]] (The word is elsewhere found only in Sm: [[1Ki.23.21|1Ki.23:21]], [[Ezk.24.21|Eze.24:21]], Test. Zeb., 4:6-7; see Thayer, see word; MM, xxiii quote Thumb, Hellen., 123 as practically confirming Lft. on [[Php.1.8|Php.1:8]], in the suggestion that the verb was a coinage of the Jewish dispersion.) †
(AS)

G4660.def:
**σκύλλω **
1. in cl., to skin, flay, rend (Æsch., Anthol.).
2. **In Hellenistic writers, to vex, trouble, annoy**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.5.35|Mrk.5:35]], [[Luk.8.49|Luk.8:49]]; pass., ἐσκυλμένοι, distressed, [[Mat.9.36|Mat.9:36]] mid., to trouble oneself, μὴ σκύλλου, [[Luk.7.6|Luk.7:6]] (frequently in π.; see MM, i, ii, and cf. M, _Pr._, 89; Abbott, _Essays_, 87; Kennedy, _Sources_, 82).†
(AS)

G4678.def:
**σοφία**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חׇכְמָה ;]
**skill, intelligence, wisdom**, ranging from knowledge of the arts and matters of daily life to mental excellence in its highest and fullest sense;
(a) **of human wisdom**: [[1Co.2.1; 2.4-5|1Co.2:1 2:4-5]], [[Jas.3.15|Jas.3:15]], [[Rev.13.18; 17.9|Rev.13:18 17:9]]; σ. Σολομῶνος, [[Mat.12.42|Mat.12:42]], [[Luk.11.31|Luk.11:31]]; Αἰγυπτίων, [[Act.7.22|Act.7:22]] Ἕλληνες σ. ζητοῦσιν, [[1Co.1.22|1Co.1:22]] σ. λόγου, [[1Co.1.17|1Co.1:17]] τ. σοφῶν, [[1Co.1.19|1Co.1:19]] (LXX); τ. κόσμου, [[1Co.1.20-21; 3.19|1Co.1:20-21 3:19]]; ἀνθρωπίνη, [[1Co.2.13|1Co.2:13]] σαρκική, [[2Co.1.12|2Co.1:12]]
**of wisdom in spiritual things**: [[Luk.21.15|Luk.21:15]], [[Act.6.3, 10; 7.10|Act.6:3, 10 7:10]], [[1Co.2.6|1Co.2:6]], [[Col.1.28; 2.23; 3.16; 4.5|Col.1:28 2:23 3:16 4:5]], [[Jas.1.5; 3.13, 17|Jas.1:5 3:13, 17]], [[2Pe.3.15|2Pe.3:15]]; λόγος σοφίας, [[1Co.12.8|1Co.12:8]] πνεῦμα σοφίας, [[Eph.1.17|Eph.1:17]] σ. καὶ φρόνησις, [[Eph.1.8|Eph.1:8]] σ. καὶ σύνεσις, [[Col.1.9|Col.1:9]]
(b) **of divine wisdom**: of God, [[Rom.11.33|Rom.11:33]], [[1Co.1.21; 1.24; 2.7|1Co.1:21 1:24 2:7]], [[Rev.7.12|Rev.7:12]]; πολυποίκιλος, [[Eph.3.10|Eph.3:10]]
of Christ, [[Mat.13.54|Mat.13:54]], [[Mrk.6.2|Mrk.6:2]], [[Luk.2.40, 52|Luk.2:40, 52]], [[1Co.1.30|1Co.1:30]] [[Col.2.3|Col.2:3]], [[Rev.5.12|Rev.5:12]];
of wisdom personified, [[Mat.11.19|Mat.11:19]], [[Luk.7.35; 11.49|Luk.7:35 11:49]].†
_SYN._: σύνεσις, intelligence; φρόνησις, prudence, which with σ. make up (Arist., N. Eth., i, 13) the three intellectual ἀρεταί. σ. is wisdom primary and absolute; in distinction from which φ. is practical, σύνεσις critical, both being applications of σ. in detail (cf. Lft., and _ICC_ on [[Col.1.9|Col.1:9]] Lft., _Notes_, 317 f.; Tr., _Syn._, § LXXv; Cremer, 870 ff.). (AS)

G4680.def:
**σοφός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for חָכָם ;]
**skilled, clever, wise, whether in handicraft, the affairs of life, the sciences or learning**: [[Rom.16.19|Rom.16:19]], [[1Co.3.10|1Co.3:10]]; of the learned, [[Rom.1.14, 22|Rom.1:14, 22]], [[1Co.1.19-20; 1.26-27; 3.18-20|1Co.1:19-20 1:26-27 3:18-20]]; of Jewish teachers, [[Mat.11.25|Mat.11:25]], [[Luk.10.21|Luk.10:21]]; Christian, [[Mat.23.34|Mat.23:34]] of those en­dowed with practical wisdom, [[1Co.6.5|1Co.6:5]], [[Eph.5.15|Eph.5:15]], [[Jas.3.13|Jas.3:13]]; of God, [[Rom.16.27|Rom.16:27]] compar., τ. μωρὸν τ. θεοῦ σοφώτερον, [[1Co.1.25|1Co.1:25]]†
_SYN._: συνετός, φρόνιμος (see: σοφία, _SYN._) (AS)

G4632.def:
**σκεῦος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for כְּלִי ;]
**a vessel, implement **(for exx. in various senses, see MM, xxii): [[Mrk.11.16|Mrk.11:16]], [[Luk.8.16|Luk.8:16]], [[Jhn.19.29|Jhn.19:29]], [[Act.10.11, 16; 11.5|Act.10:11, 16 11:5]], [[Rom.9.21|Rom.9:21]], [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]]; pl., [[2Ti.2.20|2Ti.2:20]], [[Rev.2.27|Rev.2:27]]; τὰ σ. τῆς λειτουργίας, [[Heb.9.21|Heb.9:21]] pl., τὰ σ., utensils, goods, [[Mat.12.29|Mat.12:29]], [[Mrk.3.27|Mrk.3:27]], [[Luk.17.31|Luk.17:31]]; id. of the tackle or gear of a ship (Xen., Polyb., al.); so in sing., τὸ σ., [[Act.27.17|Act.27:17]] Metaphorical, of persons: σ. ἐκλογῆς, [[Act.9.15|Act.9:15]] ὀργῆς, [[Rom.9.22|Rom.9:22]] ἐλέους, [[Rom.9.23|Rom.9:23]] σ. εἰς τιμήν (cf. [[Rom.9.21|Rom.9:21]]), [[2Ti.2.21|2Ti.2:21]]; of woman, ἀσθενέστερον σ., [[1Pe.3.7|1Pe.3:7]] so perh. τ. ἑαυτοῦ σ., [[1Th.4.4|1Th.4:4]] (but see infr.); of the body, [[2Co.4.7|2Co.4:7]] so perh. [[1Th.4.4|1Th.4:4]] (but see supr., and see: κτάομαι).†
**κτάομαι**, -ῶμαι
[in LXX chiefly for קָנָה ;]
in pres., impf., fut. and aor., **to procure for oneself, get, gain, acquire **(the pf. and plpf., to have acquired, hence to possess, do not occur in NT): with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.10.9|Mat.10:9]], [[Luk.18.12|Luk.18:12]], [[Act.8.20|Act.8:20]]; with genitive pret., [[Act.22.28|Act.22:28]] ἐκ with genitive pret., [[Act.1.18|Act.1:18]] τ,ψυχὰς ὑμῶν (MM, xvi), [[Luk.21.19|Luk.21:19]] τ. ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι, [[1Th.4.4|1Th.4:4]] (where if σ. = body, κ. must = pf., κέκτημαι; see MM, xvi; M, _Th._, in l; Field, _Notes_, 72 f. But σ. is most frequently taken as = wife; see Thayer, see word; Lft., _Notes_, 53 ff.; _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G4650.def:
**σκορπίζω **
[in LXX for פּוּץ hi., etc. ;]
in vernac. and in Ion, and late writers for σκεδάννυμι (see MM, xxiii; Rutherford, _NPhr._, 295), **to scatter**: ὁ λύκος, [[Jhn.10.12|Jhn.10:12]] ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει, [[Mat.12.30|Mat.12:30]], [[Luk.11.23|Luk.11:23]]; pass., before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[Jhn.16.32|Jhn.16:32]] of one who dispenses blessings, [[2Co.9.9|2Co.9:9]] (LXX) (of. δια-σκορπίζομαι).†
(AS)

G4690.def:
**σπέρμα**, -τος, τό
(σπείρω) [in LXX chiefly for זֶרַע ;]
**seed**;
(a) **of plants**: [[Mat.13.24, 27; 13.37-38|Mat.13:24, 27 13:37-38]], [[2Co.9.10|2Co.9:10]]; pl., [[Mat.13.32|Mat.13:32]], [[Mrk.4.31|Mrk.4:31]], [[1Co.15.33|1Co.15:33]]; metaphorically, of an escaping remnant (שָׂרִיד, [[Isa.1.9|Isa.1:9]] cf. [[Wis.14.6|Wis.14:6]] Plat., Tim., 23c; FlJ, _Ant._, xi, 5, 3), [[Rom.9.29|Rom.9:29]]
(b) of men (as γονή; Lat. semen genitale; so in cl.; cf. in LXX, [[Lev.15.16|Lev.15:16]], al.): [[Heb.11.11|Heb.11:11]]; metaphorically, of the divine influence, [[1Jn.3.9|1Jn.3:9]] by meton. (as frequently in poets), **seed, offspring, posterity**: [[Mat.22.24-25|Mat.22:24-25]], [[Mrk.12.19-22|Mrk.12:19-22]], [[Luk.1.55; 20.28|Luk.1:55 20:28]]" (LXX) [[Jhn.7.42; 8.33, 37|Jhn.7:42 8:33, 37]] [[Act.3.25; 7.5-6; 13.23|Act.3:25 7:5-6 13:23]], [[Rom.1.3; 4.13, 18; 9.7-8; 11.1|Rom.1:3 4:13, 18 9:7-8 11:1]], [[2Co.11.22|2Co.11:22]], [[Gal.3.16, 19|Gal.3:16, 19]], [[2Ti.2.8|2Ti.2:8]], [[Heb.2.16; 11.18|Heb.2:16 11:18]]; pl. (FlJ, _Ant._, viii, 7, 6; Flat., Leg., ix, 853 with; [[4Ma.18.1|4Ma.18:1]] in Ga, l.with, contrasted with sing., see Lft., in l; Milligan, _NTD_, 105 f.), [[Gal.3.16|Gal.3:16]] of spiritual offspring, [[Rom.4.16, 18; 9.8|Rom.4:16, 18 9:8]], [[Gal.3.29|Gal.3:29]], [[Rev.12.17|Rev.12:17]].†
(AS)

G4625.def:
**σκάνδαλον**, -ου, τό
(late form of the rare word σκανδάληθρον, see LS, see word) [in LXX chiefly for מוֹקֵשׁ, מִכְשׁוֹל ;]
prop., the bait-stick of a trap, a snare, stumbling-block ([[Lev.19.14|Lev.19:14]], [[Jdt.5.1|Jdth.5:1]]): figuratively, [[Rom.9.33|Rom.9:33]], [[1Pe.2.8|1Pe.2:8]] ([[Isa.8.14|Isa.8:14]]; aliter in LXX; στερεὸν σκανδάλου in Aq.). Metaphorical, of that which causes error or sin;
(a) **of persons**: [[Mat.13.41; 16.23|Mat.13:41 16:23]]; Χριστὸς ἐσταυρωμένος, [[1Co.1.23|1Co.1:23]]
(b) **of things**: [[Mat.18.7|Mat.18:7]], [[Rom.11.9|Rom.11:9]]" (LXX) [[Rom.14.13|Rom.14:13]], [[1Jn.2.10|1Jn.2:10]] [[Rev.2.14|Rev.2:14]]; τὸ σ. τοῦ σταυροῦ, [[Gal.5.11|Gal.5:11]] pl., [[Mat.18.7|Mat.18:7]], [[Luk.17.1|Luk.17:1]], [[Rom.16.17|Rom.16:17]].†
_SYN._: πρόσκομμα (AS)

G4633.def:
**σκηνή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אֹהֶל, also for מִשְׁכָּן, סֻכָּה, etc. ;]
**a tent, booth, tabernacle**: [[Mat.17.4|Mat.17:4]], [[Mrk.9.5|Mrk.9:5]], [[Luk.9.33|Luk.9:33]], [[Heb.11.9|Heb.11:9]]; αἱ αἰώνιοι σ., [[Luk.16.9|Luk.16:9]] of the Mosaic tabernacle, [[Heb.8.5; 9.2-3, 6; 9.8, 21|Heb.8:5 9:2-3, 6 9:8, 21]]; σ. τ. μαρτυρίου, [[Act.7.44|Act.7:44]] of its heavenly prototype, [[Heb.8.2; 9.11|Heb.8:2 9:11]], [[Rev.13.6; 15.5; 21.3|Rev.13:6 15:5 21:3]]; of the temple, [[Heb.13.10|Heb.13:10]] ἡ σ. τοῦ Μολόχ, [[Act.7.43|Act.7:43]] (LXX); metaphorically, ἡ σ. Δαυείδ [[Act.15.16|Act.15:16]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4641.def:
**σκληρο-καρδία**, -ας, ἡ
(σκληρός, καρδία), [in LXX: [[Deu.10.16|Deu.10:16]], [[Jer.4.4|Jer.4:4]] (לֵבָב עׇרְלָה), [[Sir.16.10|Sir.16:10]] (cf. καρδία σκληρά, [[Sir.3.26-27|Sir.3:26-27]]) * ;]
**hardness of heart**: [[Mat.19.8|Mat.19:8]], [[Mrk.10.5; 16.14|Mrk.10:5 16:14]].†
(AS)

G4623.def:
**σιωπάω**, -ῶ
(σιωπή, silence) [in LXX for חָשָׁה, חָרַשׁ hi., etc. ;]
**to be silent or still, keep silence**: [[Mat.20.31; 26.63|Mat.20:31 26:63]], [[Mrk.3.4; 9.34; 10.48; 14.61|Mrk.3:4 9:34 10:48 14:61]], [[Luk.19.4|Luk.19:4]], [[Act.18.9|Act.18:9]]; of one dumb, [[Luk.1.20|Luk.1:20]] (cf. [[4Ma.10.18|4Ma.10:18]]); addressed rhetorically to the sea, σιώπα, [[Mrk.4.39|Mrk.4:39]]†
_SYN._: ἡσυχάζω, σιγάω (which see) (AS)

G4622.def:
**Σιών **
indecl.,
in NT anarth., but in LXX when used of the city of Jerusalem, ἡ Σ.
(Heb. צִיּוֹן),
**Zion**;
1. **the mountain**: in typical sense, of the Church, [[Heb.12.22|Heb.12:22]] of heaven, [[Rev.14.1|Rev.14:1]]
2. The city, i.e. Jerusalem; in poetical sense;
(a) **of the inhabitants**: θυγάτηρ Σ, [[Mat.21.5|Mat.21:5]], [[Jhn.12.15|Jhn.12:15]]" (LXX) ;
(b) **in wider sense, of Israel**: [[Rom.11.26|Rom.11:26]]
(with) figuratively: τίθήμι ἐν Σ λίθον, [[Rom.9.33|Rom.9:33]], [[1Pe.2.6|1Pe.2:6]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4619.def:
**σιτιστός**, -ή, -όν
(σιτίζω, to fatten) [in Sm.: [[Psa.22.13|Psa.22:13]], [[Jer.46.21|Jer.46:21]] * ;]
= σιτευτός, **fattened**; as subst., pl., τὰ σ., **fatlings**: [[Mat.22.4|Mat.22:4]]†
(AS)

G4654.def:
**σκοτίζω**
(σκότος), [in LXX for חָשַׁךְ ;]
**to darken**; in NT always pass., -ομαι, **to be darkened**: of the heavenly bodies, [[Mat.24.29|Mat.24:29]], [[Mrk.13.24|Mrk.13:24]], [[Luk.23.45|Luk.23:45]] (Rec., WH, mg.), [[Rev.8.12|Rev.8:12]] Metaphorical, of the mind, [[Rom.1.21; 11.10|Rom.1:21 11:10]]" (LXX) (cf. σκοτόω).†
(AS)

G4642.def:
**σκληρός**, -ά, -όν
(σκέλλω, to dry), [in LXX chiefly for קָשָׁה ;]
**hard to the touch, rough, harsh, **(opposite to μαλακός); metaphorically, in various uses;
(a) **of men, hard, stern, severe**: [[Mat.25.24|Mat.25:24]]
(b) **of things, hard, rough, violent**: σκληρόν σοι (ἐστι), [[Act.26.14|Act.26:14]] λόγος, [[Jhn.6.60|Jhn.6:60]] ἄνεμος, [[Jas.3.4|Jas.3:4]] σκληρὰ λαλεῖν, [[Jude.15|Ju 15]].†
_SYN._: αὐστηρός, q.v (AS)

G4686.def:
**σπείρα**, -ης
(on this form of genitive, see M, _Pr._, 38, 48; Bl., § 7, 1; Mayser, 12; Deiss., BS, 186), [in LXX: [[Jdt.14.11|Jdth.14:11]], [[2Ma.8.23|2Ma.8:23]] [[2Mac.12.20|2Mac 12:20]] [[2Mac.12.22|2Mac 12:22]] * ;]
1. (= Lat. spira) anything wound or rolled up, a coil.
2. As a military term used (by Polyb. and later writers) of a body of soldiers, a maniple (third part of a cohort) or cohort (see Swete, _Mk._, 375; Westc., Jo., 251 f.): [[Mat.27.27|Mat.27:27]], [[Mrk.15.16|Mrk.15:16]], [[Jhn.18.3, 12|Jhn.18:3, 12]], [[Act.10.1; 21.31; 27.1|Act.10:1 21:31 27:1]].†
(AS)

G4682.def:
**σπαράσσω **
[in LXX: [[2Sa.22.8|2Ki.22:8]] B (גָּעַשׁ hith.), [[Jhn.4.19|Jhn.4:19]] (הָמָה) Dan LXX 8:7 (שָׁלַךְ hi.), [[3Ma.4.6|3Ma.4:6]] * ;]
1. to tear, rend, mangle.
2. **to convulse**: [[Mrk.1.26|Mrk.1:26]] (see Swete, in l) [[Mrk.9.26|Mrk.9:26]], [[Luk.9.39|Luk.9:39]]
(cf. συν-σπαράσσω).†
(AS)

G4688.def:
**σπεκουλάτωρ, -ορος (Rec. -ωρος), ὁ** (Lat. speculator),
1. prop., a spy or scout.
2. **An executioner**: [[Mrk.6.27|Mrk.6:27]] (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G4663.def:
**σκώληξ**, -ηκος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for תּוֹלָע and cogn. forms ;]
**a worm**: of the kind which preys upon dead bodies, metaphorically, of fut. punishment, [[Mrk.9.48|Mrk.9:48]] (LXX, [[Isa.66.24|Isa.66:24]] cf. [[Sir.7.17|Sir.7:17]], [[Jdt.16.17|Jdth.16:17]]).†
(AS)

G4685.def:
**σπάω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַף, ;]
in cl. poët. for ἕλκω; mostly used in mid. (cf. M, _Pr._, 157),
**to draw**: μάχαιραν, [[Mrk.14.47|Mrk.14:47]], [[Act.16.27|Act.16:27]],†
(AS)

G4669.def:
**σμυρνίζω**
(σιύρνα),
1. intrans., to be like myrrh (Diosc., i, 79).
2. Trans., **to mingle or drug with myrrh**: pass., [[Mrk.15.23|Mrk.15:23]]†
(AS)

G4608.def:
**σίκερα**, τό indecl.
(Aram. שִׁכְרָא), [in LXX for שֵׁכָר (also rendered μέθυσμα, [[Jdg.13.4|Jdg.13:4]], [[Mic.2.11|Mic.2:11]]), [[Lev.10.9|Lev.10:9]], al. ;]
**fermented liquor, strong drink**: [[Luk.1.15|Luk.1:15]]†
(AS)

G4698.def:
**σπλάγχνον**, -ου, τό mostly (in NT always) in pl., σπλάγχνα, -ων, τά,
[in LXX: [[Pro.12.10|Pro.12:10]] (רַחַם, elsewhere rendered by οἰκτιρμοί, [[Psa.25.6; 40.12|Psa.25:6 40:12]] and by ἔλεος, [[Isa.47.6|Isa.47:6]]), [[Pro.26.22|Pro.26:22]] (בֶּטֶן), [[Wis.10.5|Wis.10:5]], [[Sir.30.7|Sir.30:7]], [[2Ma.9.5|2Ma.9:5]] (6), al. ;]
**the inward parts **(heart, liver, lungs, etc.; Lat. viscera): [[Act.1.18|Act.1:18]] Metaphorical, of the seat of the feelings and of the feelings themselves (in Gk. poets, of anger, anxiety, etc.), the heart, affections (the characteristic LXX and NT reference of the word to feelings of kindness, benevolence and pity, is found in π.; see MM, xxiii; cf. Lft. on [[Php.1.8|Php.1:8]]): [[2Co.6.12; 7.15|2Co.6:12 7:15]], Phm 7 12 20, [[1Jn.3.17|1Jn.3:17]]; σ. οἰκτιρμοῦ, [[Col.3.12|Col.3:12]] σ. καὶ οἰκτιρμοὶ, [[Php.2.1|Php.2:1]] σ. ἐλέους θεοῦ; ἡμῶν, [[Luk.1.78|Luk.1:78]] σ. Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, [[Php.1.8|Php.1:8]]†
(AS)

G4683.def:
**σπαργανόω**, -ῶ
(σπάργανον, a swathing-band) [in LXX: [[Job.38.9|Job.38:9]], [[Ezk.16.4|Eze.16:4]] (חָתַל pu.)* ;]
**to swathe, wrap in swaddling-clothes**: [[Luk.2.7, 12|Luk.2:7, 12]] (Hipp., Arist., Plut.).†
(AS)

G4692.def:
**σπεύδω **
[in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi., also for בָּהַל pi., hi., etc. ;]
1. most frequently intrans., **to hasten**: with inf. (as frequently in cl.), [[Act.20.16|Act.20:16]] ptcp. with indic., [[Luk.2.16|Luk.2:16]] with imperat., [[Luk.19.5-6;|Luk.19:5-6]] σπεῦσον κ. ἔξελθε, [[Act.22.18|Act.22:18]]
2. Trans., with accusative;
(a) to hasten, urge on, accelerate (as Hom., Od., xix, 137; Eur., Med., 152; [[Sir.33.8|Sir.33:8]] ([[Sir.36.8|Sir.36:8]]): [[2Pe.3.12|2Pe.3:12]], R, mg. (cf. Mayor and _ICC_, in l, but see infr.);
(b) **to desire eagerly **(find., Pyth., iii, 110; Eur., Suppl., 161; Isa 165): 2Pe, l.with, R, txt. (but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4646.def:
**σκολιός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX: [[Deu.32.5|Deu.32:5]] (עִקֵּשׁ), [[Pro.28.18|Pro.28:18]] (σ. ὁδοῖς πορεύεσθαι, for: דֶּרֶךְ עָקַשׁ), [[Isa.40.4|Isa.40:4]] (עָקֹב), etc. ;]
**curved, bent, winding **(opposite to ὀρθός, εὐθύς): [[Luk.3.5|Luk.3:5]] (LXX). Metaphorical, **crooked, perverse, unjust**: [[Act.2.40|Act.2:40]], [[Php.2.15|Php.2:15]], [[1Pe.2.18|1Pe.2:18]].†
(AS)

G4606.def:
**Σιδώνιος**, -α, -ον
(Σιδών),
**of Sidon, Sidonian**;
(a) **the region**: sc. χώρα, [[Luk.4.26|Luk.4:26]]
(b) **the people**: [[Act.12.20|Act.12:20]]†
(AS)

G4673.def:
**σορός**, -οῦ, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Gen.50.26|Gen.50:26]] (אָרוֹן), [[Job.21.32|Job.21:32]] A * ;]
(a) **a cinerary urn **(Hom.);
(b) **a coffin **(Hdt., i, 68, 3, a1.): [[Luk.7.14|Luk.7:14]]†
(AS)

G4677.def:
**Σουσάννα**, -ης
(cf. Dan LXX TH Su, inscr., 2, 7, al.)
**Susanna**: [[Luk.8.3|Luk.8:3]]†
(AS)

G4601.def:
**σιγάω**, -ῶ
(σιγή), [in LXX for חָרַשׁ, חָשָׁה, etc. ;]
1. intrans., to be silent, **keep silence**: [[Luk.9.36; 18.39; 20.26|Luk.9:36 18:39 20:26]], [[Act.12.17; 15.12-13|Act.12:17 15:12-13]], [[1Co.14.28; 14.30; 14.34|1Co.14:28 14:30 14:34]].
2. Trans., to keep secret; pass., **to be kept secret**: [[Rom.16.25|Rom.16:25]]†
_SYN._: ἡσυχάζω, σιωπάω (AS)

G4661.def:
**σκῦλον**
(Rec. σκύλον), -ου, τό [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלָל ;]
mostly in pl., σκίλα, **arms stripped from a foe, spoils**: [[Luk.11.22|Luk.11:22]]†
(AS)

G4648.def:
**ακοπέω**, -ῶ
(σκοπός), [in LXX: [[Est.8.13|Est.8:13]], [[2Ma.4.5|2Ma.4:5]] * ;]
to look at, behold, watch, contemplate. Metaphorical, **to look to, consider**: with accusative of thing(s), [[2Co.4.13|2Co.4:13]], [[Php.2.4|Php.2:4]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Rom.16.17|Rom.16:17]], [[Php.3.17|Php.3:17]]; before μή, [[Luk.11.35|Luk.11:35]] σεαυτόν, before μή (see M, _Pr._, 192), [[Gal.6.1|Gal.6:1]] (cf. ἐπι-, κατα-σκοπέω).†
_SYN._: βλέπω, θεωρέω, ὁράω (AS)

G4620.def:
**σιτομέτριον**, -ου, τό
(σιτομετρέω, [[Gen.47.12, 14|Gen.47:12, 14]] *, = Attic τὸν σῖτον μετρέω),
**a measured portion of food**: [[Luk.12.42|Luk.12:42]] (for exx. in π., see Deiss., BS, 158; _LAE_, 103.1).†
(AS)

G4611.def:
**Σιλωάμ** (indecl., but in FlJ, genitive, ᾶ, B.J., ii, 16, 2), ὁ (Heb. שִׁלֹחַ),
**Siloam **(see _DB_, iii, 515 f.): [[Luk.13.4|Luk.13:4]], [[Jhn.9.7, 11|Jhn.9:7, 11]].†
(AS)

G4676.def:
**σουδάριον**, -ου, τό(Lat.),
**handkerchief, kerchief**: [[Luk.19.20|Luk.19:20]], [[Act.19.12|Act.19:12]]; used as a head covering for the dead, [[Jhn.11.44; 20.7|Jhn.11:44 20:7]] (cf. Deiss., BS, 223).†
(AS)

G4617.def:
**σινιάω**
(σίνιον, a sieve), = σήθω,
**to sift, winnow**: figuratively, [[Luk.22.31|Luk.22:31]]†
(AS)

G4637.def:
**σκηνόω**, -ῶ
(σκηνή), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַן ;]
**to have one's tabernacle, to dwell **(in π. of temporary dwelling, see MM, _Exp._, xxii): before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[Rev.7.15|Rev.7:15]] before ἐν, with dative of person(s), [[Jhn.1.14|Jhn.1:14]] id. with dative loc., [[Rev.12.12; 13.6|Rev.12:12 13:6]]; before μετά, with genitive of person(s), [[Rev.21.3|Rev.21:3]] (cf. ἐπι-, κατα-σκηνόω).†
(AS)

G4634.def:
**σκηνοπηγία**, -ας, ἡ
(σκηνή, πήγνυηι), [in LXX for סֻכָּה, [[Deu.16.16; 31.10|Deu.16:16 31:10]], [[Zec.14.16, 18-19|Zec.14:16, 18-19]]; I [[Est.5.51|Est.5:51]], [[1Ma.10.21|1Ma.10:21]], [[2Ma.1.9|2Ma.1:9]] [[2Mac.1.18|2Mac 1:18]] * ;]
prop., the setting up of tents or dwellings (Arist.); in LXX and NT, ἡ σ., ἡ ἑορτή τῆς σ. (called also ἑορτὴ σκηνῶν, [[Lev.23.34|Lev.23:34]], al.; see Deiss., _LAE_, 116 f.), the feast of Tabernacles: [[Jhn.7.2|Jhn.7:2]]†
(AS)

G4628.def:
**σκέλος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX for רֶגֶל, etc. ;]
**the leg from the hip downwards**: ?[[Jhn.19.3-33|Jhn.19:3-33]] †
(AS)

G4614.def:
**Σινά**
(-ᾶ, Rec.),
indecl. (but τὸ Σιναῖον, FlJ, _Ant._, iii, 5, 1; τὸ Σιναῖον ὄρος, ib. ii, 12, 1), τό
(Heb. סִינַי),
Sinai ([[Exo.19.11|Exo.19:11]], al.): [[Act.7.30, 38|Act.7:30, 38]], [[Gal.4.24-25|Gal.4:24-25]]†
(AS)

G4638.def:
**σκήνωμα**, -τος, τό
(σκηνόω), [in LXX chiefly for אֹהֶל ;]
**a tent, tabernacle **(cf. σκηνή, σκῆνος): of the temple as God's dwelling ([[Psa.132.5|Psa.132:5]], al.), [[Act.7.46|Act.7:46]]. Metaphorical, of the body: [[2Pe.1.13-14|2Pe.1:13-14]]†
(AS)

G4662.def:
**σκωληκό-βρωτος**, -ον
(σκώληξ, βιβρώσκω),
**eaten of worms**: [[Act.12.23|Act.12:23]] (cf. [[2Ma.9.9|2Ma.9:9]], and see MM, xxiii) †
(AS)

G4635.def:
**σκηνοποιός**, -όν
(σκηνή, ποιέω),
**making tents**; as subst., ὁ σ., **a tent-maker**: [[Act.18.3|Act.18:3]]†
(AS)

G4645.def:
**σκληρύνω**
(σκληρός), [in LXX chiefly for קָשָׁה hi., also for חָזַק ;]
to harden. Metaphorical, **to harden, make stubborn**: with accusative of person(s), [[Rom.9.18|Rom.9:18]] T. καρδίας ([[Psa.95.8|Psa.95:8]]), [[Heb.3.8, 15; 4.7|Heb.3:8, 15 4:7]]. Pass., **to become hardened**: [[Act.19.9|Act.19:9]], [[Heb.3.13|Heb.3:13]].†
(AS)

G4612.def:
**σιμικίνθιον** (also written σημι-), -ου, τό (Lat. semicinctium),
**a work­man's apron**: [[Act.19.12|Act.19:12]]†
(AS)

G4607.def:
**σικάριος**, -ου, ὁ
(Lat.; sica, a dagger carried under their clothing by the Sicarii),
**a bandit, assassin, one of the Sicarii **(FlJ, B.J., ii, 17, 6, al.): [[Act.21.38|Act.21:38]]†
(AS)

G4627.def:
**σκάφη**, -ης, ἡ
(σκάπτω), [in LXX: [[Bel.1.32|Dan LXX Bel 1:32]], TH [[Bel.1.33|Bel 1:33]] * ;]
anything scooped out, esp. a light boat, **skiff**: [[Act.27.16, 30; 27.32|Act.27:16, 30 27:32]].†
(AS)

G4643.def:
**σκληρότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(σκληρός), [in LXX: [[Deu.9.27|Deu.9:27]] (קְשִׁי), etc. ;]
**hardness**; metaphorically, of stubbornness: [[Rom.2.5|Rom.2:5]]†
(AS)

G4681.def:
**Σπανία**, -ας, ἡ
(= cl. Ἑσπερία or Ἰβηρία; late writers adopted the Roman name, Ἱσπανία ([[1Ma.8.3|1Ma.8:3]]) or Σ. as here),
**Spain**: [[Rom.15.24, 28|Rom.15:24, 28]].†
(AS)

G4610.def:
**Σιλουανός**
(in MSS also Σιλβανός, a form frequently in π.), -οῦ, ὁ,
**Silvanus, latinized name of Silas**: [[2Co.1.19|2Co.1:19]], [[1Th.1.1|1Th.1:1]], [[2Th.1.1|2Th.1:1]], [[1Pe.5.12|1Pe.5:12]].†
(AS)

G4636.def:
**σκῆνος**, -ους, τό
[in LXX: [[Wis.9.15|Wis.9:15]] * ;]
= σκηνή,
a tent, tabernacle (C.1., 3071). Metaphorical, of the body as the tabernacle of the soul: [[2Co.5.1; 5.4|2Co.5:1 5:4]].†
(AS)

G4647.def:
**σκόλοψ**, -οπος, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Num.33.55|Num.33:55]] (שֵׂךְ), [[Hos.2.6|Hos.2:6]] (8) (סִיר), [[Ezk.28.24|Eze.28:24]] (סִלּוֹן), [[Sir.43.19|Sir.43:19]] * ;]
anything pointed, esp.
1. in cl., a stake
2. **In Hellenistic vernacular, a thorn **(cf. LXX, ll. with): σ. τῇ σαρκί, [[2Co.12.7|2Co.12:7]] (cf. MM, i., xxiii; _DB_, iii, 700 f.; Deiss., St. Paul, 62 f.; Field, _Notes_, 187).†
(AS)

G4656.def:
**σκοτόω**, -ῶ
(σκότος), [in LXX for חָשַׁךְ, קָדַר, שָׁחַר ;]
**to darken**: [[Rev.9.2; 16.10|Rev.9:2 16:10]]. Metaphorical, of the mind! pass., [[Eph.4.18|Eph.4:18]] (cf. σκοτίζω).†
(AS)

G4696.def:
**σπίλος** (Rec. σπῖλος), -ου, ὁ
1. a rock, cliff (Arist., al.).
2. In late writers = Att.. κηλίς (see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 87 f.), a spot, stain; metaphorically,
(a) **of moral blemish**: [[Eph.5.27|Eph.5:27]]
(b) **of riotous and lascivious persons **(cf. Dion. Hal., quoted by Mayor, in l): [[2Pe.2.13|2Pe.2:13]]†
(AS)

G4689.def:
**σπένδω **
[in LXX chiefly for נָסַךְ hi. ;]
**to pour out as a drink-offering, make a libation**; pass., figuratively, σπένδομαι, **I am poured out or offered as a libation **(in the shedding of my life-blood): [[Php.2.17|Php.2:17]] (see Lft., in l), [[2Ti.4.6|2Ti.4:6]] (for exx. from π., see Milligan, Selections, 114 f.; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

G4657.def:
**σκύβαλον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX: [[Sir.27.4|Sir.27:4]] * ;]
refuse, esp. dung (see MM, ii, iii, xxiii): [[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]]†
(AS)

G4649.def:
**σκοπός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for צָפָה ;]
1. a watcher, watchman ([[Ezk.3.17|Eze.3:17]], al.).
2. a mark on which to fix the eye ([[Wis.5.12, 21|Wis.5:12, 21]], al.). Metaphorical, of an aim or object: [[Php.3.14|Php.3:14]]†
(AS)

G4658.def:
**Σκύθης**, -ου, ὁ
Scythian, an inhabitant of Scythia, i.e. Russia and Siberia, a synonym with the Greeks for the wildest of barbarians: [[Col.3.11|Col.3:11]]†
(AS)

G4684.def:
**σπαταλάω**, -ῶ
(σπατάλη, wantonness, luxury, [[Sir.27.13|Sir.27:13]] *), [in LXX: [[Ezk.16.49|Eze.16:49]] (שָׁקַט hi.), [[Sir.21.15|Sir.21:15]] * ;]
**to live riotously**: [[1Ti.5.6|1Ti.5:6]], [[Jas.5.5|Jas.5:5]] (Polyb.).†
_SYN._: στρηνιάω, τρυφάω (see Tr., _Syn._, § liv) (AS)

G4629.def:
**σκέπασμα**, -τος, τό
(σκεπάζω, to cover),
a covering, esp. clothing: [[1Ti.6.8|1Ti.6:8]]†
(AS)

G4679.def:
**σοφίζω**
(σοφός), [in LXX chiefly for חָכָם ;]
**to make wise, instruct**: with accusative of person(s), [[2Ti.3.15|2Ti.3:15]] (cf. [[Psa.19.8|Psa.19:8]] ([[Psa.119.98|Psa.119:98]]). As depon., -ομαι;
(a) intrans., to become wise (I2Ki.4:27 ([[1Ki.5.11|3Ki.5:11]]), [[Ecc.2.15|Ecc.2:15]], and frequently in [[Sir.7.5|Sir.7:5]], al.);
(b) trans., **to invent, devise cleverly**: pass., [[2Pe.1.16|2Pe.1:16]]
(cf. κατα-σοφίζομαι).†
(AS)

G4695.def:
**σπιλόω **
[in LXX: [[Wis.15.4|Wis.15:4]] * ;]
**to stain, spot, defile**: with accusative, [[Jas.3.6|Jas.3:6]], [[Jude.23|Ju 23]].†
(AS)

G4694.def:
**σπιλάς**, -άδος, ἡ
(on the gender in Ju, l.with, see Mayor, Ju., 41),
1. poët. in cl., a rock or reef over which the sea dashes (Polyb., FlJ, al.). Metaphorical, of men whose conduct causes danger to others, [[Jude.12|Ju 12]], R, txt. (but see infr.).
2. In late writers = σπίλος (which see), a spot, stain; metaphorically, Ju, l.with, R, mg. (cf. Mayor, 41, but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4667.def:
**Σμύρνα (T**, Ζμ-; B1., § 3, 9), -ας, ἡ
**Smyrna, an Ionian city on the Ægean**: [[Rev.1.11; 2.8|Rev.1:11 2:8]].†
Ζμύρνα, -ης, ἡ,
[[Rev.1.11; 2.8|Rev.1:11 2:8]] T, for Σμ-, which see (cf. B1., § 3, 9; Mayser, 204).†
(AS)

G4664.def:
**σμαράγδινος**
(σμάραγδος, which see),
1. of emerald (Luc., V.H., ii, 11).
2. As in π. (Deiss., BS, 267), **emerald-green**: [[Rev.4.3|Rev.4:3]] (for the construction, see Swete, in l; Zorell, see word).†
(AS)

G4665.def:
**σμάραγδος**, -ου, ἡ
(and in late writers also ὁ), [in LXX: [[Exo.28.9|Exo.28:9]] (שֹׁהַם) [[Exo.36.17|Exo.36:17]] ([[Exo.39.10|Exo.39:10]]) (בָּרֶקֶת), [[Ezk.28.13|Eze.28:13]] (יַהֲלֹם), etc. ;]
**emerald or other trans parent green stone **(LS, see word; _DB_, iv, 620; Swete, Ap., 67, 288): [[Rev.21.19|Rev.21:19]]†
(AS)
